senses.gloss:
ITA-6.2.6.15 chedanam छेदनम्
Corrosive action
A therapeutic action which forcibly drives out sticky dosha such as kapha.

ITA-9.6.64 chedanakarma छेदनकर्म
Excision
The procedure of excising or amputating a body part or organ.

ITA-9.6.132 chedanakarma छेदनकर्म
Excision
Excision procedure for wound management.

ITA-9.6.77 chedanabhedaḥ छेदनभेदः
Types of incision
Various types of incision based on shape, such as oblique, semicircular and circular.

ITA-9.5.8 chedyarogaḥ छेद्यरोगः
Eye disorders for excision
Eye diseases in which the surgical procedure of excision is indicated.
